verdict: Organic activity is fading and paid campaigns need to restart now.
narrative: This period, no paid ads ran on any channel, leaving your Google Business Profile as the only active source of inbound activity — and that too dropped sharply in the past week. GBP actions fell nearly 77% over the last seven days, with three consecutive days of zero actions confirmed through September 13th. Search clicks and website sessions followed the same direction, down 36% and 48% respectively over the same stretch, showing that organic demand is softening without paid activity to support it. Restarting paid campaigns is the immediate priority to stop the erosion and bring leads back in.
